scope: Assigned snapshots only; local files only. Frozen title and complete ItemBody reviewed; receipt-listed screenshot tiles viewed individually at original resolution.

diagram_candidates.verdict: potentially warranted; optional and not required for proof validity
diagram_candidates.source_claim: Prepare |+> on the vertex qubits, apply p alternating cost and mixer layers with parameters (gamma_j,beta_j), then computational-basis measure; the expected objective is <psi|C_G|psi> and each measured string is a cut.
diagram_candidates.why: The item is explicitly a circuit definition. A compact circuit schematic would expose the order of state preparation, repeated cost/mixer layers, measurement, and the sampled objective at a glance.
diagram_candidates.specific_content: Draw one wire per v in V initialized to |+>. For j=1,...,p show the cost unitary exp(-i gamma_j C_G), followed chronologically by the mixer exp(-i beta_j B_G); optionally expand them into commuting edge gates exp(-i gamma_j (I-Z_u Z_v)/2) for (u,v) in E and per-wire Rx(2 beta_j) gates. End with computational-basis measurement and label the bitstring x and cut score C_G(x), with expected score <psi|C_G|psi>. Respect the right-to-left product convention and do not imply the output is a maximum cut.
diagram_candidates.certainty: pedagogical candidate, not a defect; no current diagram to validate

diagram_candidate_review: No item has a current TikZ diagram (receipt tikz_count is zero throughout). The QAOA circuit definition is a source-supported optional teaching schematic candidate; its gate order and labels are specified above. No diagram is required for proof validity.
